# Utilane

> TypeScript / JavaScript ESM utility library for browsers and Node.js. Documentation describes the current repository; published npm versions may differ.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): installation, supported environments and the three public entry points.
- [Documentation index](docs/index.md): module map and reading order.
- [Root API](docs/api/index.md): public exports and complete type declarations for utilane.
- [Browser API](docs/api/browser.md): public exports for utilane/browser.
- [Node API](docs/api/node.md): public exports for utilane/node.

## Maintenance

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md)
- [Contributing and release workflow](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

Only the documented package entry points are public. Root hash is asynchronous Web Crypto; Node hash is synchronous and has different arguments. Base32 is RFC 4648 with strict uppercase and padding validation. Supporting declarations are not necessarily public exports. This is a repository-relative index, not a hosted discovery endpoint.
